title: (..)ibra
text:
(..)ibra
(..)ibra
(..)ibra
King of
Meluhha
Reign
Possibly between
c.
2300–2200 BC
(..)ibra
was a king of
Meluhha
according to an inscription attributed to the reign of
Naram-Sin of Akkad
(2254–2218 BC).
[
1
]
Inscription
Naram-Sin
(2254–2218 BC) was the third successor and grandson of
Sargon of Akkad
(2334–2279 BC).
He listed the various rebel kings to his rule, and mentioned "
(..)ibra
, man of Meluhha".
[
1
]
Significance
(..)ibra is the only attested ruler of Meluhha. His kingdom has been identified with the
Indus Valley Civilisation
and so, the inscription might provide some insights into the relationship between the Harappans and the
Mesopotamians
.
